name: Avidbank Holdings, Inc.
summary: Avidbank Holdings, Inc. operates as a bank holding company for Avidbank that provides financial solutions and services. It offers business and personal deposit products, such as checking, money market, and savings accounts; and certificates of deposit. The company also provides lending products, including working capital lines of credit, equipment loans, acquisition financing, shareholder buyouts, ESOP loans, and owner-occupied real estate loans; sponsor finance comprising acquisition term loans, recapitalization term loans, and working capital lines; and venture lending, such as venture debt, growth capital, recurring revenue, and treasury management services.
